name: Is Gayrimenkul Yatirim Ortakligi A.S.
summary: Is Gayrimenkul Yatirim Ortakligi A.S. is a Turkey-based real estate investment trust through the consolidation of Is Gayrimenkul Yatirim ve Proje Degerlendirme A.S. and Merkez Gayrimenkul Yatirim ve Proje Degerlendirme A.S. The company is a subsidiary of Turkiye Is Bankasi A.S. and operates under the regulations of the Capital Markets Board of Turkey applicable to real estate investment corporations. Its principal activities include investing in income-generating real estate assets, real estate development projects, and property-related capital market instruments in line with regulatory portfolio limits.
